items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has knee injury, questionable to return (in-game).
items.opportunity: If OUT rest of way, handcuff carries.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is out on the field in Brazil testing his hamstring; looks good as team mulls decision. True pregame GTD, team not counting on him playing.
items.why: Hamstring; pregame workout on soggy field looks good but team pessimistic.
items.implication: Late swap risk; Bateman/Andrews upside if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Bateman primary WR, Andrews targets rise.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell (finger, Q/GTD) inactive vs Lions. Saw team-high 12 targets last week.
items.implication: Wilson/others elevated; TE Sadiq more slot/wide.
items.opportunity: Garrett Wilson target share up; Isaiah Williams/Pritchett depth.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play and is active vs Chargers.
items.why: Shoulder injury from TNF; cleared and active.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snaps expected; limited per ETR.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) expected to play and active vs Bengals. Dowdle OUT.
items.why: Shoulder; expected and confirmed active. Dowdle ruled out.
items.implication: Feature back with Dowdle out; high-end RB2.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker active; Xavier Legette inactive/out.
items.why: Ankle; expected and active. Legette knee out.
items.implication: Coker startable WR3/flex with target share.

items.text: With AD Mitchell inactive, Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Expect TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Mitchell inactive confirmed; depth chart clear.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 elevated targets; Sadiq sneaky.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets up; Sadiq hybrid role.

items.text: ETR/Levitan have Zay Flowers OUT in projections; possible play but late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore in but limited; Mitchell out.
items.why: No counting on Flowers; Moore limited assumption.
items.implication: Avoid Flowers or late swap; Moore cautious start.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Andrews if Flowers out; Moore reduced snaps.
items.conflict: Workout looks good may flip to limited IN.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers expected to play (knee Q).
Eagles Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith expected to play.
Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring; 3-4 week injury per sources (with Rapoport).
items.implication: Bagent or other starts multi-weeks; Chicago pass catchers down.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume to WRs/TEs limited.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT (hamstring, 2nd straight); decent chance return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring; multi-week but progressing for W4.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 28% target share last week continues.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot, Q) expected to play vs Bengals.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets with Steelers pass game.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) plans to play/good to go vs Arizona.
items.why: Hip; plans to play per sources.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak Cowboys run D; high prop.
items.opportunity: Volume and YPC upside vs poor front.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches, 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows league-high YPR to WRs); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% ts w/ Collins out, IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ ts).
items.opportunity: Olave volume; Schultz elevated targets; Watson RZ.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, tough run D); Travis Etienne vs LV (low snaps/touches even w/ Kamara); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (worst WR fantasy D, low team total).
items.opportunity: Stevenson losing to Henderson; Etienne committee; McLaurin suppressed.
